issues.description: The problem statement (Aufgabe 10) requests the IDs of all Radwege that lead to Gemeinden in Oberfranken or Unterfranken, but the solution query returns Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name instead of an identifier. This contradicts the specification and will confuse students about whether to select an ID column or the name, and may cause tests to expect different output than the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution (and template if necessary) to return the Radweg identifier column instead of the name, e.g. SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id (or the correct ID column name) FROM Radweg_zu_Gemeinde, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberfranken' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Unterfranken'). Alternatively, if the intent was to return names, adjust the problem statement to ask for Radweg names instead of IDs.
